# E0364: a lens's pattern tests a field that may be absent

A pattern that compares a field tests a field that may be absent. In CUE,
comparing an absent field is an error rather than false, so the lens fails on
every instance that lacks the field. Test presence first.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				c?: string
			}
		}
	}
	"1": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				q?: int
			}
		}
	}
}
lenses: {
	"0.0->1.0": {
		input: _
		result: {
			if input.c == "x" {
				q: 1
			}
		}
	}
	"1.0->0.0": {
		input: _
		result: {}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0364]: the result of lens 0.0->1.0 is not total for some instance
  --> lineage.cue:22:4
   |
22 |             if input.c == "x" {
   |             ^^
   |
   = note: the result of lens 0.0->1.0 is under the pattern input.c == "x", but input.c may be absent (input.c is optional in the source schema), and comparing an absent field is an error rather than false; test presence first: if input.c != _|_
   = note: a lens must be total: every instance of schema 0.0 must translate to an instance of schema 1.0 (totality rule pattern-absent)
```
